assistant.question: What are the best ligands for separating Eu from La?
assistant.answer:
smart_toy

Based on the REEL-QUEST database, here are the top 10 ligands for separating Eu from La, ranked by the absolute value of log separation factor (|log SF|):

Rank	Ligand	Family	Median log SF	Separation Factor (SF)	Preference	Conditions
1	DBPhthA	Phthalamic_acid	4.30	19,953	Eu	1
2	CA-BTP	Multident_N_donor	2.95	899	Eu	1
3	DODGA	DGA	2.53	337	Eu	1
4	DODMDGA	DGA	2.45	284	Eu	1
5	DOdMAPTA	DAPhen	−2.45	0.004	La	2
6	DHTPhBLPhen	BLPhen	−2.41	0.004	La	2
7	PrODGA	DGA	2.37	236	Eu	1
8	DMDecODGA	DGA	2.36	228	Eu	1
9	DCPhenDA-EtHexPh	DAPhen	−2.35	0.005	La	1
10	EtODGA	DGA	2.23	169	Eu	1
Key Observations
Eu-preferring ligands (positive log SF): Dominated by DGA-type extractants (DODGA, DODMDGA, PrODGA, DMDecODGA, EtODGA) plus the standout DBPhthA (phthalamic acid) and CA-BTP (multidentate N-donor).
La-preferring ligands (negative log SF): DAPhen and BLPhen phenanthroline derivatives (DOdMAPTA, DHTPhBLPhen, DCPhenDA-EtHexPh).
DBPhthA is exceptional, showing a separation factor ~20,000× for Eu over La—far above the rest.
The DGA family provides the most numerous high-performing Eu-selective ligands, consistent with their known ascending (heavy-REE) selectivity trend.

Data from 105 ligands with paired Eu/La measurements; “Conditions” = number of paired experimental conditions averaged.
